title: Enterprise OIDC Centralized Authentication & Access Management
shortDescription: Centralized Identity Provider (IdP) adhering to OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 specifications with PKCE support, delivering secure Single Sign-On (SSO) and role-based access control across all corporate webapps, portals, and mobile apps.

overview.summary: Engineered a centralized Identity Provider (IdP) compliant with OpenID Connect Core 1.0 and OAuth 2.0 specifications, acting as the unified authentication gateway for all analytical webapps, management portals, and mobile client apps across the ecosystem.
overview.background: Previously, standalone applications managed isolated user databases, requiring repetitive logins and complicating user administration for corporate partners. Centralizing identity unified the user experience and significantly elevated system security.

challenge.title: Secure Authentication & Seamless Login Experience
challenge.problem: Integrating heterogeneous clients (Next.js SPAs, React Native mobile apps, backend microservices) into a single centralized identity platform while maintaining rapid, user-friendly authentication flows.
bottlenecks: Securing authorization codes on mobile applications and Single Page Applications using industry standards.
Ensuring responsive session revocation when users log out or change passwords.
Optimizing token verification overhead so backend business APIs stay lightweight and fast.

solution.title: Identity Provider Implementation with PKCE & Redis JWKS Key Caching
solution.approach: Built with Laravel Passport enhanced with standard OIDC discovery endpoints (`/.well-known/openid-configuration`), utilizing RS256 asymmetric signing and caching JWKS public keys in Redis for high-speed token validations.
keyInnovations: Enforced PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) flow across all public web SPAs and mobile applications.
Automated periodic RSA key pair rotations published via signed JWKS endpoints.
Flexible Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) accommodating organization admins, medical staff, and end users.

architecture.overview: Clean, secure, and extensible centralized identity architecture.

layers.detail: Clean, responsive sign-in interface supporting device remembering and seamless navigation.

layers.tech: PHP / Laravel, OpenID Connect Provider Core
layers.detail: Issues ID Tokens, Access Tokens (JWT Bearer), and Refresh Tokens with secure expiration handling.
Maintains active session states and facilitates rapid token revocation when needed.
Safeguards account credentials with industry-standard bcrypt hashing and organizational role mappings.

features.title: Seamless Single Sign-On (SSO)
features.description: Users sign in once at the central identity portal to securely navigate across reporting webapps, wellness portals, and mobile apps.
technicalHighlights: Synchronized logout coordination across linked client applications.
Clear, transparent consent screens specifying requested access scopes.

features.title: Corporate Account & Permission Management
features.description: Provides organization managers with tools to manage team members, assign operational roles, and review access activity.
technicalHighlights: Account activation status controls and secure password recovery mechanisms.
System audit logs tracking access events for administrative review.

visuals.title: Intuitive Authentication Experience
visuals.caption: Clean, secure login interface designed for enterprise and end-user convenience.

visuals.title: Corporate Role & Session Administration
visuals.caption: Management interface overseeing active sessions and organization access roles.

takeaways: Adopting the OpenID Connect standard establishes a reliable foundation across all applications within the corporate ecosystem.
Caching public verification keys (JWKS) via Redis ensures verification queries execute swiftly without bottlenecking the database.
